label: Eleven Music (hosted, ElevenLabs)
_note: ElevenLabs' own music API (read 2026-11-06, https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/music/compose.md): POST /v1/music answers with the file. A prompt, a length in ms (3,000 to 600,000), force_instrumental; a seed can't go with a prompt. Its docs say the model holds a stated BPM and key, and that its music is cleared for nearly all commercial uses by plan (https://elevenlabs.io/music-terms). A composition plan would place lyrics and section lengths exactly; not used until a prompt's words are heard to fall short. No proof by a paid take yet.

capabilities._note: Songs with the lyrics in the prompt, score with force_instrumental; the tempo, key and arc in the words.
